title: Fixed asset and construction-in-progress review with depreciation
prompt: Review the fixed asset and construction-in-progress schedules. Identify assets ready for service, calculate depreciation under approved policies and propose entries.

setup.q: Below what amount is an invoice expensed when paid rather than set up as a prepaid or an asset?
What useful life applies to each asset class?
Which depreciation method and convention apply (straight-line, mid-month, half-year)?
Which accounts hold construction in progress?

inputs.name: Fixed asset and CIP workbook with in-service evidence

steps: pull Dime's fixed asset schedule and the month's depreciation run; read the CIP account ledgers for the period
read the FA and CIP workbook and the in-service evidence: Dime's documents first, then a document request
list CIP items with evidence of being ready for service (delivery, installation, go-live) and the asset class and life they would take
run depreciation_recalc over the schedule under the stated lives and convention; list every asset where the recalculated month differs from Dime's

propose the month's depreciation run from the existing schedule (tier A); raise capitalizing a CIP item as a question (tier C), becoming a tier B proposal once the in-service date and life are confirmed
tie: schedule cost and accumulated depreciation to the ledger accounts; CIP listed items to the CIP balance

done.text: Every exception row cites the asset id or CIP transaction id and the evidence document
fixed-asset-review.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every proposed depreciation or capitalization entry balances to the penny

Assets ready for service are listed with the evidence and date; every depreciation difference shows Dime's figure and the recalculated one; a capitalization is a question first and a proposal only after the in-service date and life are confirmed

tierRules.when: the month's depreciation from the existing schedule under the stated policy
moving a CIP item into service before the in-service date and useful life are confirmed
the in-service date and useful life are confirmed by the approver
